entry.summary: I work with different AI coding tools, including codex, Claude,, Opencode, cursor, and others. Also, I work on several projects under different folders. This makes managing skills, AGENTS.md files, MCPs so hard. I'm not sure what is installed where. Also, agents create memory files nowadays with instructions that I find misleading, so i wanna read and edit these memory files occasionally. Thats why I created a tool with proper UI to manage all of these.
